_README: Per-file corrections to the generated index. THIS is how the Unidentified pile shrinks.
The generator matches keywords against filenames, which fails for anything named after a
DOI, a hash, or a download counter. Rather than rename the original — never rename the
original — you record the truth here and regenerate.
Shape, keyed on the EXACT filename as it sits in raw/:
"title": "Applied Behavior Analysis in Children and Youth with Autism",
title    -> what the index calls it. Also feeds keyword matching, so a good title can
place a file on the right shelf by itself.
category -> an id from wiki/_config.json, or 'media' / 'unidentified'. Optional.
Every entry you add is a permanent improvement: the file stays untouched, and the index
gets smarter. Ask Claude to fill these in for you — that is what the tend-the-garden
